name: Catchrecord Pattern
description: To represent the catch records from time series FIGIS application, which contain temporally-indexed aggregated information about aquatic species cacthing.
scenarios: We are able to query time-series data for catches of species in a certain fishing area, by vessels of some country, with anounts and measurement units.
competency_questions: What species, and what amount of organisms, have been caught from what areas, countries, at what date and fishing year?
